products.name: Shared iPad for Frontline Teams — Managed Apple IDs, ABM & Microsoft 365 Session Isolation — Commercial
products.short_description: Stop shared iPads leaking the last user's mailbox — deploy Apple Shared iPad with Managed Apple IDs so every shift change fully clears the Microsoft 365 session.
products.description:
Stop shared iPads leaking the last user's mailbox — deploy Apple Shared iPad with Managed Apple IDs so every shift change fully clears the Microsoft 365 session.

Passing a standard single-user iPad between shifts gives no per-user session boundary: Microsoft 365 apps keep the previous user's tokens and cached data, so the next user opens Outlook and sees someone else's mail. Signing out of one app doesn't clear the others. This solution fixes it properly — Apple Shared iPad (ADE + supervised + Managed Apple IDs federated to Entra ID) for true per-user data separation and clean sign-out, the Managed Apple ID reclamation plan for staff whose work email is tied to a personal Apple ID, a strict field lockdown (no App Store, no personal apps), and a validation gate that proves user B cannot see user A's data.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Root-cause analysis + architecture decision — Apple Shared iPad vs Microsoft 365 Shared Device Mode, and when each applies
  • Apple Shared iPad deployment — ABM/ADE enrollment profile with Shared iPad enabled, supervision, storage sizing for per-user partitions
  • Managed Apple ID + ABM federation to Entra ID, and the reclamation plan for work emails tied to personal Apple IDs (domain conflict resolution)
  • Strict field lockdown — no App Store, no personal apps, app allowlist for CMMS/schematics/camera/limited M365
  • Session-isolation validation — the explicit user-A/user-B test proving the mailbox and data are gone at sign-out, plus shift-handover runbook

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Shift-based iPads where every sign-out truly ends the session — the next user gets a clean device, with the Managed Apple ID and lockdown work done properly instead of hoping app sign-out is enough.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SHAREDIPAD-AppleIDConflict.ps1 — builds the Entra-side CANDIDATE worklist for the Managed Apple ID
    • SHAREDIPAD-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness discovery for Apple Shared iPad on iPadOS
    • SHAREDIPAD-Report.ps1 — fleet report: per-device Shared iPad readiness and state
    • SHAREDIPAD-Set-Restrictions.ps1 — assigns and verifies the field lockdown profile assignment
    • SHAREDIPAD-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL scoring of the Shared iPad success criteria

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
